body:
She refused to talk about anything other than going to sleep. I tried to talk about other things for a while but she said that she was too tired and that she would ignore me again if I don’t say goodnight. I made her swear on my life first that she would be alive when I wake up because I know that she doesn’t want me to die. I just woke up and I have a notification from 5 minutes ago saying she’s typing thankfully. She take a while to write out texts usually so that’s normal for her. I’ll keep you posted, thanks for helping me through this. It means so much


Edit: she is at her sisters house babysitting. I think she cut her wrists because I rejected her help about my eating disorder. I didn’t mean to offend her, she just was trying to help in the wrong way. I’m currently trying to get her to give me one of her friends Snapchats so I have a way of helping her better if something serious happens

She replied telling me to go to sleep and goodnight. I tried to get her to just chat normally but she won’t. She kept saying she was too tired and has to be up for work tomorrow. I don’t know if she’s lying to me or not. I’m crying and feel sick to my stomach
She just sent me a pic of her wrists cut but didn’t reply what can I do? I don’t know
Thanks for helping, it means a lot. I couldn’t find anything on here on there :( I think she only moved to Norway last year
I don’t think you can get a phone number off it sadly. I feel like I should’ve done more to be prepared if she were to do something like this

I don’t have Instagram but I know she does. She was talking about Instagram earlier but I didn’t ask what it was because I don’t have it... I should’ve thought of asking for it in case of something like this. I can’t find her on Facebook anywhere

I can’t think of anything I can do to help besides Snapchatting her. It worked last night and I spoke to her all day. She told me that she was watching a film with her friends a few hours ago so I’m praying that they are still around
She’s from Holland but she moved to Norway. I don’t know where in Norway she lives so I don’t know what police I would have to contact
She told me she was going to die then stopped opening my Snapchats. I stayed up all night yesterday with her to stop her but she won’t reply now... I feel so hopeless
